Sliding Puzzle (15 Puzzle)

The classic 15-puzzle — a guaranteed-solvable shuffle, move counter, and win detection on a 4×4 grid.

0
Moves
—
Best

Tap a tile next to the gap to slide it.

📖 How to use

  1. Press New Game for a fresh shuffle.
  2. Tap tiles next to the empty space to slide them.
  3. Arrange tiles 1–15 in order.
  4. Get the gap to the bottom-right to win!

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is every shuffle solvable?

The board is shuffled by making hundreds of random legal moves from the solved state, so every puzzle is solvable.

How do I play?

Tap a tile next to the empty space to slide it in. Arrange 1–15 in order with the gap bottom-right.

Is there a move limit?

No — the move counter tracks your efficiency. Try to beat your best!

Can I reshuffle?

Yes — press New Game for a fresh guaranteed-solvable shuffle.
